description: This file contains implementation of bit manipulation functions for a vector-based bit buffer, including packing and unpacking bits, with hardware acceleration using AVX512, AVX2, and SSE instructions. It also includes functions for copying bits with offsets.

methods.name: unpack_8bit
methods.description: Unpacks a byte into individual bits stored in a span of uint8_t, using bitwise operations.

methods.name: pack_8bit
methods.description: Packs 8 bits from a span of uint8_t into a single byte, using bitwise operations.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks bits from a packed bit_buffer into a span of uint8_t, with hardware acceleration for large data.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Overloaded function to unpack bits from a bit_buffer into a span of uint8_t with an offset.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span of uint8_t into an unsigned integer, with maximum of 32 bits.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Overloaded function to pack bits from a span of uint8_t into an unsigned integer.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span of uint8_t into a bit_buffer, with hardware acceleration for large data.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Overloaded function to pack bits into a bit_buffer with an offset.

methods.name: copy_offset
methods.description: Copies bits from an input bit_buffer to an output bit_buffer starting at a specific position, with hardware acceleration.

methods.name: copy_offset
methods.description: Copies bits between buffers with specified offsets and length, handling unaligned bit positions.
